Package com.bupt.ta.service

Class WorkloadService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.WorkloadService
public final class WorkloadService extends Object
Computes TA workload statistics and module-organiser (MO) approval snapshots.

Aggregates application counts and position lists per TA user for admin dashboards, and builds MoWorkloadSnapshot views for pending applications so MOs (and AI advice) can assess whether approving another role would overload an applicant.

  • Method Details

    • buildTaWorkloadStats

      public Map<String,TaWorkloadStats> buildTaWorkloadStats(List<User> users, List<Application> appList)
      Builds per-TA workload counters from registered TA users and their applications.

      Only users with role Roles.TA receive stats rows. Applications increment total, accepted, rejected, or pending counts and append formatted position lines.

      Parameters:
      users - all users (typically from AuthService.listAllUsers())
      appList - all applications to aggregate; may be null
      Returns:
      map keyed by TA user id to TaWorkloadStats; never null

    • buildSnapshotForApplication

      public MoWorkloadSnapshot buildSnapshotForApplication(String applicationId, List<Application> applications, List<Job> jobs, String applicantName)
      Builds a workload snapshot for a single pending application.

      Returns null when the application id is invalid, the application is not found, or its status is not Pending. The snapshot includes accepted and pending positions for the same applicant plus estimated hours from job postings.

      Parameters:
      applicationId - id of the pending application under review
      applications - full application list to scan for the target and sibling rows
      jobs - job postings used to resolve workload hours by module code
      applicantName - display name for the applicant; falls back to user id when blank
      Returns:
      snapshot for MO review, or null when not applicable

    • buildSnapshotsForPendingApplications

      public Map<String,MoWorkloadSnapshot> buildSnapshotsForPendingApplications(List<Application> applications, List<Job> jobs, Map<String,String> applicantNamesByUserId)
      Builds workload snapshots for every pending application in the list.

      Keys the result map by application id. Applicant names are resolved from applicantNamesByUserId when provided.

      Parameters:
      applications - applications to evaluate (only Pending rows produce snapshots)
      jobs - job postings for hour lookup
      applicantNamesByUserId - optional map from user id to display name
      Returns:
      map of application id to snapshot; empty when input list is null
